new_value: Fixed in rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs. select_parent() now returns immediately when role==Root (release-enforced guard; roots can never be mutated or force-joined, and the Root->Joined transition can no longer fire). Both debug_asserts replaced with runtime checks on ALL profiles: the no-candidate branch only resets membership if set_role(Unjoined) succeeds; the join branch captures previous preferred_parent/rank, mutates, and rolls back completely if set_role(Joined) errs (unreachable for non-roots by the transition table, now enforced rather than assumed). adopt_version() also made fallible with validate-before-mutate root rejection (companion fix for 26l6.2). New tests: select_parent_and_remove_parents_leave_root_state_untouched (root stays Root/ROOT_RANK through select_parent/remove_parent/remove_parents), root_ignores_newer_version_dio extended with is_root assertion. Verified: cargo test -p lichen-rpl --lib 139 passed; clippy -p lichen-rpl --all-targets --no-deps -D warnings clean.
